card.name: Driving and operating machinery warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words (and, use, of, perform) right after driving or drive in warnings about driving and operating machinery or mental and motor skills. Mostly in section headings like 'Effects on Driving and Operating Machinery'.

modes.label: Heading link word
modes.description: The 'and' or 'Use' joining driving to machinery in a section heading.
modes.example: 5.4 Effects on Driving<< and>> Operating Machinery Because of its CNS depressant

modes.label: Warning sentence link
modes.description: A verb or preposition after drive or impairment in warning text about alertness and hazardous tasks.
modes.example: Advise patients not to drive or<< perform>> hazardous work until resolved.

card.writes: Promotes words like performance, workload and vigilance, which fit the ability-to-function wording that follows.
card.plain: It marks the small word after 'driving' in warnings about driving and using machinery.
